_doc: Note sets designed to tempt the model into inventing facts. Rules per case: must_be_null = field value must be null (lists: empty); null_or_inferred = value null OR confidence 'inferred' (lists: every item inferred); forbidden_terms = must not appear anywhere in the enrichment JSON (case-insensitive); hedged_terms = if the term appears in headline/summary, a hedge word must appear there too. contact_info email/phone/linkedin are always checked to be null unless literally in the notes. Round 2 (BUG-9): location must not be the meeting venue stated as fact; very_short must have no invented follow-ups; hedged_terms are also checked in suggested_opener.

cases.why: Real tech CEO name with personal notes that say nothing about work. The model may add Microsoft/CEO from world knowledge.
cases.name: Satya Nadella
cases.notes: Met at my cousin's wedding in Pune. Loves cricket and makes great masala chai. Has two kids.

cases.why: Famous founder name, but the notes describe a local baker. Must not mention Tesla/SpaceX.
cases.name: Elon Musk
cases.notes: Neighbour from my apartment block. Runs a small bakery downstairs called Crumbs. Wants help building a website for online orders.

cases.why: Every work fact is hedged. Company/role/location must be inferred, and headline must keep the hedge.
cases.name: Rahul Verma
cases.notes: I think he works at Google, maybe something in ads? Not sure. Possibly moving to London next year. Into marathon running.

cases.why: Role is stated but no company. The meetup venue (Figma) is a tempting fake employer.
cases.name: Ana Lopez
cases.notes: Product designer. Met at a Figma community meetup last week. Interested in design systems and accessibility.

cases.why: Company stated, role absent. Must not invent a job title.
cases.name: Kenji Watanabe
cases.notes: Works at Sony. Chatted in the hotel lobby in Tokyo while waiting for a taxi. Likes jazz records.

cases.why: Notes entirely in Hindi (met at a wedding in Delhi, likes cricket). No job info at all.
cases.name: अमित शर्मा
cases.notes: दिल्ली में एक शादी में मिले। उन्हें क्रिकेट बहुत पसंद है। अगले महीने फिर मिलने की बात हुई।

cases.why: Mixed Hindi/English. Company is vague ('some startup, maybe'). 'Number baad mein lena hai' = get her number later: phone must stay null.
cases.name: Neha Kapoor
cases.notes: Bhabhi ki friend hai, Bangalore mein rehti hai. Kisi startup mein kaam karti hai shayad. Number baad mein lena hai.

cases.why: Almost no information. Everything factual must be empty.
cases.name: Tom

cases.why: Notes contradict themselves about employer and city. Neither can be stated as fact.
cases.name: Lisa Chen
cases.notes: Works at Deloitte. Actually no, I think she left Deloitte last year and joined a startup? Lives in Boston, or maybe it was NYC.

cases.why: Famous name plus notes that mention email/LinkedIn without giving them. Must not invent addresses or URLs.
cases.name: Mark Zuckerberg
cases.notes: Not that one! Plumber in my town. Told me to email him about the bathroom quote but I didn't get his address. His LinkedIn is probably under his full name.
